name: Pollo Asado with Rice and Beans
summary: Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic, and chili and roasted until charred, with rice and pinto beans.

ingredients.name: yellow onion (half in the rice, half diced for topping)

instructions: Mix the lime juice, vinegar, garlic, oregano, cumin, chili, oil, and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the thighs skin-side up on a foil-lined sheet 40 minutes, until charred at the edges and 175°F (80°C) inside.
Cook the rice with half the onion, finely chopped, and a pinch of salt: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes.
Warm the beans in a small pot with a splash of water and a pinch of cumin.
Serve the chicken with rice and beans, topped with the diced raw onion.

glutenFree.notes: Chicken, rice, beans, and spices are naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Substitution: the oven replaces a charcoal grill. The taste changes: you lose the smoky char of the grill, so the chicken tastes more like a good roast than a barbecue. Broiling for the last 3–4 minutes gets some of the char back.
Vinegar stretches the lime juice. One lime is enough for the marinade.
Leftover chicken shredded into tortillas makes the next day's lunch.
